query:
SELECT lc.quantite * COALESCE(lc.remplace_prix_unites, pf.prix_unites)
                          AS "montant!",
                      pf.devise
               FROM commandes.ligne_commande lc
               JOIN prestataires.prix_fige pf ON pf.id = lc.prix_fige_id
               WHERE lc.id = $1
